posts.hook: A rocket's upper stage came back from orbit and a tower plucked it out of the air
posts.caption: spacex caught a starship upper stage with its launch tower for the first time, though the booster catch on the same flight was called off. elon musk and other tech executives signed a petition asking nvidia to reinstate jensen huang, and linkedin and monster removed more than 1,000 fake job postings after a cbc investigation. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: SpaceX catches the Starship upper stage for the ==first time==
slides.desc: The planned booster catch was aborted. Each half has now been caught, not yet on one flight.

slides.title: Musk and other tech executives petition Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
slides.desc: A petition from peers has no formal weight with the board or ordinary shareholders.

slides.title: Why Huang could lose Nvidia: he had ==no super-voting shares==
slides.desc: Forbes: Zuckerberg, Dell and Spiegel hold majority voting power. Huang did not.

terms.gloss: stock that gives a founder extra votes per share

slides.title: A data center developer asks Oracle and Meta to backstop its electricity
slides.desc: Bloomberg: Applied Digital sought billions in guarantees before leases were final.

slides.title: LinkedIn and Monster remove more than 1,000 fake job postings
slides.desc: They came down only after a CBC investigation found them.

posts.hook: The US Treasury now has an opinion on who should run Nvidia
posts.caption: treasury secretary scott bessent urged nvidia to hire an outside ceo and wants answers within 10 days on china chip sales. a new york times investigation reports commerce secretary howard lutnick pushed to narrow chip curbs affecting a client of his former firm, and apple's first smart glasses are reported set for a wwdc reveal. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Bessent urges Nvidia to hire an outside CEO, wants answers ==within 10 days==
slides.desc: The question: did Nvidia push "seemingly illicit" chip sales to China to boost revenue?

terms.gloss: scott bessent, the US treasury secretary

slides.title: NYT: Lutnick pushed to narrow chip curbs affecting a client of his former firm
slides.desc: The commerce secretary writes the rules; the Cantor Fitzgerald client's data center may serve Tencent.

terms.gloss: the wall street firm lutnick ran before joining the government

slides.title: Apple's first smart glasses: a WWDC reveal next June, ==no AR display==
slides.desc: The bet is Siri AI controlling iPhone apps, an app catalog Meta's glasses do not have.

terms.gloss: apple's yearly developer conference, held in june

slides.title: Meta held Muse for seven months before launching it
slides.desc: It began as a weekend with an open-source agent on a Raspberry Pi, its product lead says.

slides.title: Whisper large-v3 now runs on a laptop in under 1 GB, no Python needed
slides.desc: Transcription joins image generation and voice cloning on ordinary hardware.

slides.title: The first AI Music Awards needed human stand-ins
slides.desc: Variety: AI announcers, lip-syncing and a ceremony mired in technical issues.
